description.en: A draggable todo note for DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 会话用的可拖拽待办便签。

description.en: Draggable sticky note in the DeepSeek Harness shell: short-term tasks (now / next / parked) plus a long-term plan with phases, one file the agent and you both read.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的可拖拽便签：短期任务（现在 / 下一步 / 已搁置）加长期计划分阶段进度，代理和你读的是同一份文件。
